lines.text: Hello there, adventurer! Always good to see a new face.
My name's Ashwyn. I'm an alchemist here in Ravengard.
I offer medical treatments and remedies for a fair price.
Things haven't been easy these last few months with so many wounded soldiers, but we do our best to help those in need.
You don't seem to be injured. Let's hope it stays that way!
If you need any medical supplies, or perhaps healing remedies, don't hesitate to come see me.
